clip_file: float32 rows of 71 per 50 Hz frame: root_pos 3 | root_quat 4 (wxyz) | joint_pos 29 | root_lin_vel_w 3 | root_ang_vel_w 3 | joint_vel 29 (joint order of assets/policy/meta.json)

fields.name: label shown on the page
fields.kind: pose (needs no motion data) | clip (a rows file next to this index)
fields.source: where the motion comes from (dataset, subject/trial, or how it was authored)
fields.licence: licence of the original motion data
fields.retargeting: how the motion was retargeted to the G1 (kind clip)
fields.loop: clip restarts from its first frame after the last (clips start and end in the default pose)
fields.default: the motion the page opens on
